defmodule Orchestra.Fleet do
  use Ash.Domain,
    otp_app: :orchestra

  resources do
    resource Orchestra.Fleet.Node
    resource Orchestra.Fleet.Rollout
    resource Orchestra.Fleet.Placement
    resource Orchestra.Fleet.Approval
    resource Orchestra.Fleet.Lease
  end

  defdelegate register_node(name, region, slots_total),
    to: Orchestra.Fleet.Node,
    as: :register

  defdelegate register_node(name, region, slots_total, opts),
    to: Orchestra.Fleet.Node,
    as: :register

  defdelegate get_node(name), to: Orchestra.Fleet.Node, as: :get

  defdelegate list_nodes(), to: Orchestra.Fleet.Node, as: :read
  defdelegate list_rollouts(), to: Orchestra.Fleet.Rollout, as: :read
  defdelegate list_placements(), to: Orchestra.Fleet.Placement, as: :read
  defdelegate list_approvals(), to: Orchestra.Fleet.Approval, as: :read
  defdelegate list_leases(), to: Orchestra.Fleet.Lease, as: :read

  def plan_rollout(targets) do
    if not is_list(targets) or targets == [] do
      {:error, invalid_argument(:targets, "targets cannot be empty")}
    else
      validate_targets(targets, MapSet.new(), %{total_slots: 0, names: []})
    end
  end

  defp validate_targets([], _, %{total_slots: ts, names: names}) do
    {:ok, %{total_slots: ts, node_names: Enum.sort(names), target_count: length(names)}}
  end

  defp validate_targets([t | ts], seen, acc) do
    cond do
      not is_map(t) or not is_binary(Map.get(t, :node_name)) ->
        {:error, invalid_argument(:targets, "each element must be a map with a node_name string")}

      is_binary(Map.get(t, :slots)) ->
